## Professional background
Guillermo Navarro has over six years of professional software development experience, including mobile banking, financial services, insurance software, web applications, cloud APIs, and independent SaaS products.

- Banco General (2022–present): Full Stack Developer working on mobile banking, commercial payment capabilities, Angular/Ionic, Java/Spring Boot and AWS.
- ASSA (2020–2022): Software development with .NET Core, React and React Native.
- Diprocess (2019–2020): Software development.
- Education: Software Development degree, Universidad Tecnológica de Panamá.

## Selected work
- Panaloyal: Digital loyalty and rewards SaaS for businesses. https://panaloyal.com/
- WrappedMe: iOS photo-story app using on-device Apple Vision and Apple Intelligence. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/camera-roll-stories-wrappedme/id6790265801
- Portfolio: Bilingual Astro portfolio. https://github.com/Guille0197/portafolio

## Technical focus
TypeScript, Angular, React, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, mobile development, SaaS. Exploring applied AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agent workflows; these are areas of exploration, not claims of production deployment.
